chapters.title: Overview
chapters.description: About the Why Simulation? webbook, how to contribute, contacts, and the ArticulateArena citation.

chapters.title: Text-only LLM → VLM → VLA
chapters.description: From language and images to robot actions: why opening a drawer leads us to simulation.

chapters.title: 3D generation
chapters.description: From images to 3D models: point clouds and meshes, rendering tools, Gaussian projection, cabinet videos, and interactive opacity comparisons.

chapters.title: Parts, joints, and motion
chapters.description: Learn how articulated objects work through a moving cabinet, joint controls, and an interactive connection tree.

chapters.title: Frames, orientation & URDF
chapters.description: Learn about base frames, object orientation, meshes, and URDF origins through a cabinet and its drawer.

chapters.title: Reading a URDF file
chapters.description: Read a cabinet URDF with illustrated examples of links, visual shapes, sliding and rotating joints, collision shapes, and the base link.

chapters.title: Changing a URDF
chapters.description: Watch what happens when we change a drawer’s direction, turn a hinge into a slide, remove a part, or swap shapes while keeping the joints.

chapters.title: From animation to simulation
chapters.description: Compare chosen positions with simulated motion, then see how pulling force, mass, friction, and letting go change a drawer’s movement.
